title: Quantum Readiness & Strategy
breadcrumb: Services > Quantum & Advanced Compute > Quantum Readiness & Strategy
meta_description: Quantum Readiness & Strategy from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Buyers rarely need another definition of quantum readiness & strategy. They need to know what ships first, what it touches and how value is proven. That is what this page carries: A quantum plan that survives a CFO — inventory, risk clocks and sequenced roadmaps.

Quantum strategy fails when it is either hype or paralysis. We run readiness assessments that inventory quantum-relevant workloads (optimization, simulation, ML), identify where quantum or quantum-inspired methods could beat current approaches within 3 years, and map the security clock — which cryptographic assets face harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure. The output is a sequenced roadmap with near-term projects that pay for themselves and a watch-list with trigger conditions.

We build the internal capability too: a quantum working group with named sponsors, literacy curriculum for architects and risk teams, vendor and hardware-landscape briefings, and pilot governance. The discipline is economic: every proposed quantum initiative carries a classical baseline it must beat, measured on the same benchmark.

Quantum Readiness & Strategy delivery today concentrates in Banking & Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Logistics & Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Industrial. The metric is chosen with your finance lead, and the baseline is signed before any build begins.
